report.summary: Cross-file analysis of shard 17 reveals potential orphaned modules (inventory, ikarus_chat) with no DEPENDS within the shard. Orphaned writes: metrics.py outputs offload_metrics.local.jsonl, runbook.py writes runs/ directory, neither has a READ consumer here. CLAIMS for test_council_livewire.py lack corresponding SYMBOLS. Several READS (e.g., OUTBOX, INBOX, TODO_PATH in status.py) have no WRITES in this shard. Possible duplicate health-assessment responsibility between status.py and doctor.py.

Orphaned module: daedalus/ikarus_chat.py — BLUEPRINTS, draft(), chat() have no incoming DEPENDS in this shard.
Orphaned write: daedalus/metrics.py writes memory/offload_metrics.local.jsonl — no matching READ in shard.
Orphaned write: daedalus/runbook.py writes runs/ directory — no matching READ in shard.
Unverified CLAIMS: tests/test_council_livewire.py has four CLAIMS lines, but no SYMBOLS from that file are present in the shard, making them unsubstantiated.
Missing writer for READS: daedalus/status.py reads OUTBOX, INBOX, TODO_PATH, events file, and git repo, but no WRITES for these resources appear in shard (might be outside).
Possible duplicate responsibility: daedalus/status.py and daedalus/doctor.py both provide subsystem health assessment, risking silent divergence.
